rows.name: ARKLOW N. LT.-VESSEL
rows.description: In 18 fms., 3½ miles S.E. by E. ¾ E. from North buoy of Arklow Bank. Light shows 2 quick flashes, followed by 45 secs. darkness. One mast with ball, and jigger mast

rows.name: Arklow Harbour
rows.description: Red light on N. pier, bright light on S. pier

rows.name: WICKLOW HEAD
rows.character: 1. One occulting br. lt. 2. One fix. br. or red lt.
rows.description: 1. White tower, 46 ft. high. Lt. vis. 10 secs., eclipsed 3 secs. Two towers to W.N.W. 2. On pier, red seaward, bright in harbour

rows.name: CODLING BANK LT.-V.
rows.description: In 9 fathoms, at 4½ miles S.E. ½ S. from South end of bank. Black, with 3 masts; globe over half globe at main

rows.name: KISH LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 13 fms., 1½ mile N.E. of North end of Kish Bank. Has three masts, with ball at main

rows.name: Kingstown
rows.character: 1. One rev. lt., ½ min. 2. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. Tower, 41 ft. high, on East pier. Light is bright and red alternately. Masked North of S.E. ½ S., to clear Muglin Rocks 2. Granite tower on West pier

rows.name: POOLBEG
rows.description: White lighthouse, on end of South Bull Wall, at mouth of River Liffey

rows.name: North Bull Wall
rows.description: Black lighthouse on extremity, about 330 yds. northward of Poolbeg lt.-ho. Light shows bright for 10 secs., and is then eclipsed 4 secs.

rows.name: River Liffey
rows.description: Beacon lt.-ho. No. 1 on N. side of river chanl., 1½ mile within the entr., and 500 yds. westward of beacon No. 5. A flash every 4 secs.

rows.name: North Wall, East end
rows.description: Black lt.-ho. A fixed bright light is also shown on edge of North bank, ¾ mile farther out

rows.name: HOWTH-BAILEY
rows.description: White tower, 42 feet high, on S.E. point of Howth Peninsula

rows.name: Howth Harbour
rows.description: White lighthouse, 37 ft. high, on E. pier-head

rows.name: Skerries Bay
rows.description: On pier; vis. betw. N. ¾ W. & S. by W. ¾ W.

rows.name: Balbriggan
rows.character: One fix. bright or red lt.
rows.description: White tower, 53 ft. high, on pier, South side of entrance. Red sector over Skerries between S.E. and S.E. by S. ½ S.

rows.name: ROCKABILL
rows.character: One flash. br. or red lt.
rows.description: Gray tower, 105 ft. high. Lt. shows a flash every 12 secs.; bright seaward from S. ¾ E. to N.E. by N. ¼ N.; red to westward

rows.name: Drogheda
rows.character: 1. Two fix. br., 1 red lt. 2. One fixed br. Tide lt. 3. One green, five br. lts.
rows.description: 1. Iron frames on sandhills, S. of River Boyne. Changeable as sandbank shifts. East and West lights in one, lead in 2. Stone beacon on Bluff Head, N. bank of River Boyne. Lt. shown from ½-flood to ½-ebb, between S.E. ½ E. and N.W. ½ W., through South 3. On perches in inner channel

rows.name: Dundalk
rows.character: One flashing bright or red light, 15 secs.
rows.description: On screw piles in entrance. Bright lt. seaward from E. ½ N. to S. by E. ½ E; thence masked over Dunany Reefs to S.S.W.; thence red over S.W. banks to N.W. by W.; thence bright over channel, but masked from N. ½ W. to E. ½ N. over N.E. sandbanks

rows.name: Thirteen beacon lights
rows.description: Between the bar and quay

rows.name: LOUGH CARLINGFORD
rows.character: 1. Two fixed bright lts. 2. Two fixed br. leading lights 3. One rev. br. lt., ¾ m. 4. One fixed red light
rows.description: 1. In one white tower, 111 ft. high, on Haulbowline Rock. Lower lt. or ball from half-flood to half-ebb. A small red light shown to N.E. 2. Two iron pile lighthouses, ¾ mile N. by W. from No. 1, 500 yds. apart. In one N.W. by N. ¾ N. lead through new cut in 14 ft. Obscured North of S.W. by W. ¾ W. 3. White lighthouse, 41 ft. high, on Greenore Point. Light obscured East of N. ¼ W. 4. On Greenore pier

rows.name: DUNDRUM BAY
rows.description: On St. John Point. Red 45 secs., eclipsed 15 s. Shaded across the bay to N. of W. by N. ½ N.

rows.name: Dundrum Harbour
rows.description: Two small bright tide lights on old quay

rows.name: Ardglass Harbour
rows.description: Fix. lt. at head; br. in chan., red over dangers

rows.name: SOUTH ROCK LT.-VES,
rows.description: Supersedes S. Rock lt.-ho. In 30 fms., 1 mile E. of Ridge Shoal. Black, with ball at main
